name: How can you tell if addition framing has been done correctly?

mainEntity.name: How can you tell if addition framing has been done correctly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quality framing is identified by plumb walls, level plates, square corners, and snug connections at all joints and headers. Studs should be evenly spaced on center according to architectural specifications, with proper double top plates and rated metal hangers securing high-stress connections. In addition, quality framing features accurately sized rough openings that align with the specific doors and windows to be installed, preventing sticking sashes or drafts later during finish carpentry and trim installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper framing features plumb, level, and square wall assemblies, flush header joints, secure structural hangers, and exact rough openings matching window and door specs.
